verses.geez:
ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወደቂቅከ ፡ ወቤተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ትነሥኡ ፡ ኀጣይአ ፡
                  ክህነትክሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house shall bear the sins of the holy things, and thou and thy sons shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house shall bear the sins of the holy things, and thou and thy sons shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul către Aaron: "Tu, fiii tăi şi casa tatălui tău cu tine veţi purta păcatul pentru nepăsarea de locaşul sfânt; tu şi fiii tăi împreună cu tine veţi purta păcatul pentru nepăsarea de preoţia voastră.

verses.geez:
ወአኀዊከኒ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ አቡከ ፡ አስተጋብእ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወይትወሰኩ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወይትለአኩከ ፡ ወአንተ ፡
                  ወደቂቅከ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And take to thyself thy brethren the tribe of Levi, the family of thy father, and let them be joined to thee, and let them minister to thee; and thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And take to thyself thy brethren the tribe of Levi, the family of thy father, and let them be joined to thee, and let them minister to thee; and thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
translations.ron: Apropie-ţi pe fraţii tăi, seminţia lui Levi, neamul tatălui tău, ca să fie pe lângă tine şl să-ţi slujească; iar tu şi fiii tăi împreună cu tine veţi fi la cortul adunării.

verses.geez:
ወይዕቀቡ ፡ ሕ[ገ] ከ ፡ ወሕጋ ፡ ለደብተራከ ፡ ዳእሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ንዋይ ፡ ዘቅድሳት ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ኢይባኡ ፡
                  ወኢይሙቱ ፡ እሙንቱሂ ፡ ወአንትሙሂ ።
verses.translation: And they shall keep thy charges, and the charges of the tabernacle; only they shall not approach the holy vessels and the altar, so both they and you shall not die.

translations.lxx: And they shall keep thy charges, and the charges of the tabernacle; only they shall not approach the holy vessels and the altar, so both they and you shall not die.
translations.kjv: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
translations.ron: Leviţii să păzească cele rânduite de tine şi să facă slujbă la cort, dar să nu se apropie de lucrurile locaşului sfânt şi de jertfelnic, ca să nu moară şi ei şi voi.

verses.geez:
ወይትወሰኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወይዕቀቡ ፡ ሕጋ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ግብራ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ወዘእምነ ፡ ባዕድ ፡
                  ዘመድ ፡ ኢይባእ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
verses.translation: And they shall be joined to thee, and shall keep the charges of the tabernacle of witness, in all the services of the tabernacle; and a stranger shall not approach to thee.

translations.lxx: And they shall be joined to thee, and shall keep the charges of the tabernacle of witness, in all the services of the tabernacle; and a stranger shall not approach to thee.
translations.kjv: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
translations.ron: Să fie deci pe lângă tine şi să facă slujbă la cortul adunării şi toate lucrările la cort; iar altul să nu se apropie de tine.

verses.geez: ወተዐቅቡ ፡ ሕጎሙ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ወሕጎ ፡ ለምሥዋዕ ፡ ወኢይመጽእ ፡ እንከ ፡ መንሱት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And ye shall keep the charges of the holy things, and the charges of the altar, and so there shall not be anger among the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And ye shall keep the charges of the holy things, and the charges of the altar, and so there shall not be anger among the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Aşa să faceţi slujba în locaşul sfânt şi la jertfelnic, şi nu va mai veni mânia asupra fiilor lui Israel;

verses.geez:
ወአነ ፡ ነሣእክዎሙ ፡ ለአኀዊክሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሀብተ ፡ ተውህቡ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ግብራ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ መርጡል ።
verses.translation: And I have taken your brethren the Levites out of the midst of the children of Israel, a present given to the Lord, to minister in the services of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And I have taken your brethren the Levites out of the midst of the children of Israel, a present given to the Lord, to minister in the services of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Că am ales din fiii lui Israel pe fraţii voştri, pe leviţi, şi vi i-am dat ca dar închinat Domnului, să facă slujbă la cortul adunării;

verses.geez:
ወአንተ ፡ ወደቂቅከ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ዕቀቡ ፡ ክህነተክሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለምሥዋዕ ፡ ወዘውስጥ ፡ እምነ ፡
                  መንጦላዕት ፡ ወግበሩ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ሀብታ ፡ ለ[ክህነት] ክሙ ፡ ወዘእምነ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ ዘመድ ፡ ዘቦአ ፡ ለይሙት ።
verses.translation: And thou and thy sons after thee shall keep up your priestly ministration, according to the whole manner of the altar, and that which is within the veil; and ye shall minister in the services as the office of your priesthood; and the stranger that comes near shall die.

translations.lxx: And thou and thy sons after thee shall keep up your priestly ministration, according to the whole manner of the altar, and that which is within the veil; and ye shall minister in the services as the office of your priesthood; and the stranger that comes near shall die.
translations.kjv: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for everything of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
translations.ron: Iar tu şi fiii tăi să vă îndepliniţi preoţia voastră în toate cele ce ţin de jertfelnic şi ce se află înăuntru după perdea, şi să săvârşiţi slujbele darului vostru preoţesc, iar altul străin, de se va apropia, să fie omorât".

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ናሁ ፡ አነሂ ፡ ወሀብኩክሙ ፡ ትዕቀቡ ፡ ዘያቀድሙ ፡ አብኦ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ
                  ፡ ዘይትቄደስ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለከ ፡ ወሀብኩካሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ ትረሥእ ፡ ወእምድኅሬከ ፡ ለደቂቅከ ፡
                  ሕግ ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Aaron, And, behold, I have given you the charge of the first-fruits of all things consecrated to me by the children of Israel; and I have given them to thee as an honour, and to thy sons after thee for a perpetual ordinance.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Aaron, And, behold, I have given you the charge of the first-fruits of all things consecrated to me by the children of Israel; and I have given them to thee as an honour, and to thy sons after thee for a perpetual ordinance.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul către Aaron: "Iată Eu am dat în seama voastră pârga Mea din toate cele închinate Mie de fiii lui Israel: ţie ţi le-am dat acestea şi după tine fiilor tăi, pentru cinul vostru, pentru preoţia voastră, prin lege veşnică.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ይክንክሙ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዘይትቄደስ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ዘመሣውዕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ቍርባኖሙ ፡ ወእምነ ፡
                  ኵሉ ፡ መሥዋዕቶሙ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘንስሓሆሙ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘኀጣይኢሆሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘያመጽኡ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እምነ ፡
                  ኵሉ ፡ ዘቅዱሳን ፡ ለከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወለደቂቅከ ።
verses.translation: And let this be to you from all the holy things that are consecrated to me, even the burnt-offerings, from all their gifts, and from all their sacrifices, and from every trespass-offering of theirs, and from all their sin-offerings, whatever things they give to me of all their holy things, they shall be thine and thy sons'.

translations.lxx: And let this be to you from all the holy things that are consecrated to me, even the burnt-offerings, from all their gifts, and from all their sacrifices, and from every trespass-offering of theirs, and from all their sin-offerings, whatever things they give to me of all their holy things, they shall be thine and thy sons'.
translations.kjv: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
translations.ron: Iată ce este al tău din cele preasfinte, în afară de cele ce se dau focului: orice dar de pâine al lor, orice jertfă pentru păcat a lor şi orice jertfă pentru vină, ce-Mi aduc ei, aceste lucruri preasfinte să fie ale tale şi ale fiilor tăi.

verses.geez: በቅዱሰ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ ብልዕዎ ፤ ኵሉ ፡ ተባዕት ፡ ለይብልዖ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወደቂቅከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: In the most holy place shall ye eat them; every male shall eat them, thou and thy sons: they shall be holy to thee.

translations.lxx: In the most holy place shall ye eat them; every male shall eat them, thou and thy sons: they shall be holy to thee.
translations.kjv: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
translations.ron: Acestea să le mâncaţi în locul cel sfânt. Tu şi fiii tăi, toţi cei de parte bărbătească ai voştri pot să mănânce din ele. Cele sfinte să fie ale tale.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ይኩንክሙ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቀዳሜ ፡ ሀብቶሙ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘያበውኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፤ ለከ ፡
                  ወሀብኩካሃ ፡ ወለደቂቅከ ፡ ወአዋልዲከሂ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፤ ኵሉ ፡ ዘንጹሕ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤትከ ፡ ይብልዖ ።
verses.translation: And this shall be to you of the first-fruits of their gifts, of all the wave-offerings of the children of Israel; to thee have I given them and to thy sons and thy daughters with thee, a perpetual ordinance; every clean person in thy house shall eat them.

translations.lxx: And this shall be to you of the first-fruits of their gifts, of all the wave-offerings of the children of Israel; to thee have I given them and to thy sons and thy daughters with thee, a perpetual ordinance; every clean person in thy house shall eat them.
translations.kjv: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
translations.ron: Şi iată ce să mai fie al vostru din darurile lor ridicate: toate darurile ridicate ale fiilor lui Israel şi toate darurile lor legănate ţi le-am dat ţie şi fiilor tăi şi fiicelor tale, care sunt cu tine, prin lege veşnică. Tot cel curat din casa ta poate să mănânce din acestea.

verses.geez:
ኵሎ ፡ ቀዳምያተ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ቀዳምያተ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወዘስርናይ ፡ ቀዳምያቲሆሙ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘያበውኡ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ለከ ፡ ወሀብኩካሁ ።
verses.translation: Every first-offering of oil, and every first-offering of wine, their first-fruits of corn, whatsoever they may give to the Lord, to thee have I given them.

translations.lxx: Every first-offering of oil, and every first-offering of wine, their first-fruits of corn, whatsoever they may give to the Lord, to thee have I given them.
translations.kjv: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
translations.ron: Toată pârga de untdelemn şi toată pârga de struguri şi pârga grâului lor, toate câte aduc ei Domnului, ţi le-am dat ţie.

verses.geez:
ወኵሎ ፡ ቀዳሜ ፡ እክል ፡ ዘበኵሉ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘያመጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ለከ ፡ ወሀብኩካሁ ፡ ኵሉ ፡
                  ዘንጹሕ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤትከ ፡ ይብልዖ ።
verses.translation: All the first-fruits that are in their land, whatsoever they shall offer to the Lord, shall be thine: every clean person in thy house shall eat them.

translations.lxx: All the first-fruits that are in their land, whatsoever they shall offer to the Lord, shall be thine: every clean person in thy house shall eat them.
translations.kjv: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
translations.ron: Cele dintâi roade ale pământului lor, pe care le aduc ei Domnului, să fie ale tale, şi tot cel curat din casa ta poate să mănânce din acestea.

verses.geez: ኵሉ ፡ ዘያሐርሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለከ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: Every devoted thing among the children of Israel shall be thine.

translations.lxx: Every devoted thing among the children of Israel shall be thine.
translations.kjv: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
translations.ron: Tot ce este afierosit în Israel să fie al tău.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ዘይሪትሕ ፡ ማኅፀነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሥጋ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘያመጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ እስከ ፡
                  እንስሳ ፡ ለከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ [አላ ፡] በቤዛ ፡ ይትቤዘው ፡ በኵረ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወበኵረ ፡ እንስሳሂ ፡ ዘርኩስ ፡ ታቤዙ ።
verses.translation: And every thing that opens the womb of all flesh, whatsoever they bring to the Lord, whether man or beast, shall be thine: only the first-born of men shall be surely redeemed, and thou shalt redeem the first-born of unclean cattle.

translations.lxx: And every thing that opens the womb of all flesh, whatsoever they bring to the Lord, whether man or beast, shall be thine: only the first-born of men shall be surely redeemed, and thou shalt redeem the first-born of unclean cattle.
translations.kjv: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
translations.ron: Tot ce se naşte întâi din tot trupul, din oameni şi din dobitoace, şi se aduce Domnului, să fie al tău; dar întâiul născut dintre oameni să se răscumpere şi întâiul născut dintre dobitoacele necurate să se răscumpere;

verses.geez: ወቤዛሁ ፡ ለዘ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ወርኁ ፡ ሤጡ ፡ ፭ሰቅሎ ፡ በሰቅሎ ፡ ዘቅዱስ ፡ ፳ኦቦሊ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And the redemption of them shall be from a month old; their valuation of five shekels—it is twenty oboli according to the holy shekel.

translations.lxx: And the redemption of them shall be from a month old; their valuation of five shekels—it is twenty oboli according to the holy shekel.
translations.kjv: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
translations.ron: Iar preţul răscumpărării lui, la o lună după naştere, este cinci sicli de argint, după siclul sfânt, care are douăzeci de ghere.

verses.geez:
ዘእንበለ ፡ በኵረ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ወበኵረ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ወበኵረ ፡ አጣሊ ፡ ዘኢታቤዙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወትክዑ
                  ፡ ደሞሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ወሥብሖሙ ፡ ትገብር ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወመዐዛ ፡ ሠናይ ።
verses.translation: But thou shalt not redeem the first-born of calves and the first-born of sheep and the first-born of goats; they are holy: and thou shalt pour their blood upon the altar, and thou shalt offer the fat as a burnt-offering for a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

translations.lxx: But thou shalt not redeem the first-born of calves and the first-born of sheep and the first-born of goats; they are holy: and thou shalt pour their blood upon the altar, and thou shalt offer the fat as a burnt-offering for a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.
translations.kjv: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Însă întâiul născut al vacilor, întâiul născut al oilor şi întâiul născut al caprelor, nu se răscumpără: aceştia sunt sfinţiţi; cu sângele lor să stropeşti jertfelnicul. Grăsimea lor s-o arzi ca jertfă, întru miros de bună mireasmă Domnului;

verses.geez: ወሥጋሁ ፡ ይኩንከ ፡ ለከ ፡ በከመ ፡ ተላዕ ፡ ዘያበውኡ ፡ ወበከመ ፡ መዝራዕት ፡ ዘየማን ፡ ይኩንከ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: And the flesh shall be thine, as also the breast of the wave-offering and as the right shoulder, it shall be thine.

translations.lxx: And the flesh shall be thine, as also the breast of the wave-offering and as the right shoulder, it shall be thine.
translations.kjv: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
translations.ron: Iar carnea lor este a ta şi tot ale tale sunt pieptul înălţat şi şoldul drept.

verses.geez:
ኵሉ ፡ መባእ ፡ ዘቅዱስ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይፈልጡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሀብኩካሁ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለደቂቅከ ፡
                  ወለአዋልዲከ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ ወሥርዐት ፡ ዘለ ፡ ዘላፉ ፡ እንተ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
                  ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለዘርእከ ፡ እምድኅሬከ ።
verses.translation: Every special offering of the holy things, whatsoever the children of Israel shall specially offer to the Lord, I have given to thee and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, a perpetual ordinance: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the Lord, for thee and thy seed after thee.

translations.lxx: Every special offering of the holy things, whatsoever the children of Israel shall specially offer to the Lord, I have given to thee and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, a perpetual ordinance: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the Lord, for thee and thy seed after thee.
translations.kjv: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
translations.ron: Toate darurile sfinte, înălţate, care se aduc Domnului de fiii lui Israel, ţi le dau ţie, fiilor tăi şi fiicelor tale care sunt cu tine, prin lege veşnică. Acest legământ de necălcat este veşnic înaintea Domnului pentru tine şi pentru urmaşii tăi".

verses.geez:
ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአሮን ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ ኢትወርስ ፡ ወአልብከ ፡ ክፍለ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ አነ ፡
                  ውእቱ ፡ ክፍልከ ፡ ወርስትከ ፡ በማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any portion among them; for I am thy portion and thine inheritance in the midst of the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any portion among them; for I am thy portion and thine inheritance in the midst of the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul către Aaron: "În pământul lor nu vei avea nici moştenire, nici parte nu vei avea între ei. Eu sunt partea ta şi moştenirea ta între fiii lui Israel,

verses.geez:
ወለደቂቀ ፡ ሌዊኒ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ወሀብክዎሙ ፡ ዓሥራተ ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ክፍሎሙ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡
                  ዘይገብሩ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And, behold, I have given to the sons of Levi every tithe in Israel for an inheritance for their services, whereinsoever they perform ministry in the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And, behold, I have given to the sons of Levi every tithe in Israel for an inheritance for their services, whereinsoever they perform ministry in the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Iar fiilor lui Levi, iată, Eu le-am dat moştenire toată zeciuiala din toate câte are Israel, pentru slujba lor pe care o fac la cortul adunării.

verses.geez: ወኢይበውኡ ፡ እንከ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይኩኖሙ ፡ አበሳ ፡ ዘለሞት ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel shall no more draw nigh to the tabernacle of witness to incur fatal guilt.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel shall no more draw nigh to the tabernacle of witness to incur fatal guilt.
translations.kjv: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
translations.ron: De acum fiii lui Israel să nu mai vină la cortul adunării, ca să nu facă păcat aducător de moarte.

verses.geez:
ወይግበሮ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ሌዋዊ ፡ ወእሙንቱ ፡ ይረክቡ ፡ ኀጣይኢሆሙ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡
                  በመዋዕሊሆሙ ፡ ወኢይወርሱ ፡ ርስተ ፡ በማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And the Levite himself shall perform the service of the tabernacle of witness; and they shall bear their iniquities, it is a perpetual statute throughout their generations; and in the midst of the children of Israel they shall not receive an inheritance.

translations.lxx: And the Levite himself shall perform the service of the tabernacle of witness; and they shall bear their iniquities, it is a perpetual statute throughout their generations; and in the midst of the children of Israel they shall not receive an inheritance.
translations.kjv: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
translations.ron: Ci la cortul adunării să facă slujba leviţii şi să ia asupră-şi păcatul lor. Aceasta este lege veşnică în neamul vostru.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ዓሥራቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵ[ሎ] ፡ መባ[አ] ፡ ዘይፈልጡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሀብክዎሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን
                  ፡ ክፍሎሙ ፡ ወበበይነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ እቤሎሙ ፡ ኢትወር[ሱ] ፡ ርስተ ፡ በማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: Because I have given as a distinct portion to the Levites for an inheritance the tithes of the children of Israel, whatsoever they shall offer to the Lord; therefore I said to them, In the midst of the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

translations.lxx: Because I have given as a distinct portion to the Levites for an inheritance the tithes of the children of Israel, whatsoever they shall offer to the Lord; therefore I said to them, In the midst of the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
translations.kjv: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
translations.ron: Dar printre fiii lui Israel ei nu vor avea moştenire, căci zeciuiala fiilor lui Israel, pe care aceştia o aduc dar Domnului, am dat-o leviţilor moştenire şi de aceea le-am şi zis Eu că nu vor avea moştenire între fiii lui Israel".

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Apoi a grăit Domnul lui Moise şi a zis:

verses.geez:
ንግሮሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትብል ፡ ለእመ ፡ ነሣእክሙ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዓሥራተ ፡
                  ዘወሀብኩክሙ ፡ እምኀቤሆሙ ፡ ክፍ[ለ] ክሙ ፡ ትፈልጡ ፡ አንትሙሂ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ መባአ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዓሥራቱ ፡ ለዓሥራት
                  ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt also speak to the Levites, and shalt say to them, If ye take the tithe from the children of Israel, which I have given you from them for an inheritance, then shall ye separate from it a heave-offering to the Lord, a tenth of the tenth.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt also speak to the Levites, and shalt say to them, If ye take the tithe from the children of Israel, which I have given you from them for an inheritance, then shall ye separate from it a heave-offering to the Lord, a tenth of the tenth.
translations.kjv: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.
translations.ron: "Vorbeşte leviţilor şi le zi: Când veţi lua de la fiii lui Israel zeciuiala, pe care v-am dat-o ca moştenire, să înălţaţi din ea dar Domnului a zecea parte, ca zeciuială,

verses.geez:
ወይትኌለቍ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ መባአክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ስርናይ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ እክል ፡ ወከመ ፡ መባእ ፡ ዘእምውስተ ፡
                  ምክያደ ፡ ወይን ።
verses.translation: And your heave-offerings shall be reckoned to you as corn from the floor, and an offering from the wine-press.

translations.lxx: And your heave-offerings shall be reckoned to you as corn from the floor, and an offering from the wine-press.
translations.kjv: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
translations.ron: Şi vi se va socoti acest dar al vostru ca grâul din arie şi ca mustul de la teasc.

verses.geez:
ከማሁ ፡ ፍልጡ ፡ አንትሙሂ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ መባእ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ ዓሥራቲክሙ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ዘትነሥኡ ፡
                  እምነ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወትሁብዎ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ካህን ፡ መባአ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: So shall ye also separate them from all the offerings of the Lord out of all your tithes, whatsoever ye shall receive from the children of Israel; and ye shall give of them an offering to the Lord to Aaron the priest.

translations.lxx: So shall ye also separate them from all the offerings of the Lord out of all your tithes, whatsoever ye shall receive from the children of Israel; and ye shall give of them an offering to the Lord to Aaron the priest.
translations.kjv: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD’s heave offering to Aaron the priest.
translations.ron: Astfel veţi aduce şi voi dar Domnului din toate zeciuielile voastre, câte veţi lua de la fiii lui Israel, şi veţi da din ele, dar Domnului, preotului Aaron.

verses.geez: ኵሎ ፡ ዘይቀድሙ ፡ አብኦ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ይትቄደስ ።
verses.translation: Of all your gifts ye shall offer an offering to the Lord, and of every first-fruit the consecrated part from it.

translations.lxx: Of all your gifts ye shall offer an offering to the Lord, and of every first-fruit the consecrated part from it.
translations.kjv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
translations.ron: Din toate cele dăruite vouă, cele mai bune din toate cele sfinţite să le aduceţi dar Domnului,

verses.geez:
ወበሎሙ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ትፈልጡ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቀዳምያት ፡ ወይትኌለቍ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ከመ ፡ እክል ፡ ዘእምውስተ ፡ ዐውዱ
                  ፡ ወከመ ፡ ወይን ፡ ዘእምውስተ ፡ ምክያዱ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt say to them, When ye shall offer the first-fruits from it, then shall it be reckoned to the Levites as produce from the threshing-floor, and as produce from the wine-press.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt say to them, When ye shall offer the first-fruits from it, then shall it be reckoned to the Levites as produce from the threshing-floor, and as produce from the wine-press.
translations.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
translations.ron: Şi să le spui: De veţi aduce din acestea partea cea mai bună, se va socoti leviţilor ca cele primite de la arie şi ca cele primite de la teasc.

verses.geez:
ወትበልዕዎ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መካን ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ወአብያቲክሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዐስብክሙ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ህየንተ ፡
                  ግብረክሙ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And ye shall eat it in any place, ye and your families; for this is your reward for your services in the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And ye shall eat it in any place, ye and your families; for this is your reward for your services in the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Aceasta să o mâncaţi oriunde voi, şi fiii voştri, şi familiile voastre, căci aceasta vă este plata pentru munca voastră la cortul adunării.

verses.geez:
ወኢይከውነክሙ ፡ በእንቲአሁ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ እስመ ፡ ታወፅኡ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ቀዳምያቲሁ ፡ ወኢታርኵሱ ፡ ቅድሳቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ
                  ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትሙቱ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall not bear sin by reason of it, for ye shall have offered an offering of first-fruits from it, and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that ye die not.

translations.lxx: And ye shall not bear sin by reason of it, for ye shall have offered an offering of first-fruits from it, and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that ye die not.
translations.kjv: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta nu veţi avea păcat, de veţi aduce cele mai bune din toate; şi sfintele prinoase ale fiilor lui Israel nu le veţi întina şi nu veţi muri".
